sessionState.title: Naukri session (Playwright storage state)
sessionState.description: The contents of your data/state.json. THIS IS YOUR LOGIN - it is stored in this actor's key-value store on Apify's infrastructure. Leave it empty to run signed out, which returns fewer fields and no recommendations.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Datacenter IPs are blocked by Naukri's bot protection. Residential is the setting that works, and the expensive one.
